model: Barn Find - Bokeh 3 Ekar - Available 56CM & 58CM SEPIA
description:
Bokeh 3 - WAS £3665 - NOW £3000

Introducing the latest evolution of our iconic Bokeh gravel bike. Building on the success of its predecessor, we've made intelligent and informed changes to enhance the riding experience while staying true to our philosophy of #RideDrivenDesign.

The Bokeh is our multi-award winning, Italian crafted, custom tubed, premium Dedacciai aluminium framed 'AdventureSport' machines for fast ‘Continent Crushing’ rides and they can use either 650b x 55mm or 700c, with up to 45mm tyres. Many customers specify 2 sets of wheels, and a quick swap dials the Bokeh perfectly to your chosen terrain or adventure.

Drawing upon feedback from over 4500 gravel riders and racers, Campagnolo's debut multi-terrain 13spd. groupset delivers the brand's iconic durability, proprietary ergonomics and rich heritage crafted into the world's lightest gravel groupset.

Featuring exclusive gearing ratio options with close range steps for smooth gear changes and a natural cadence progression at cruising speeds, progressing to bigger ratio changes for big ascents.

Ekar's evolution of thumb shifting Ergopower - 'Lever 3' - can be operated from anywhere on the bars without needing to lift a finger from the drop. One lever, one action and laser-enrgaved textures on hoods. Wide and smooth brake lever blades with reach adjust to suit any hand size.

There's so much thinking and neat detailing in our products that it's really impossible to tell you all about it here. There's further information, including sizing advice, in the 'TECHNICAL INFO' section below, or If you would like to find out more, or book a test-ride, please CONTACT US HERE.

You can read the Bokeh3 Bike Perfect 5 STAR Review HERE.

Our latest Bokeh 3 frameset with top-tube mounting bosses, exclusive dropouts and brazed eyelets.

Also available with Ritchey VentureMax WCS Flare 'bars in all sizes.

A choice of HUNT disc wheelsets in 650B and 700C sizes.

This bike can be fitted with the Mason Luminance Upgrade. The ultimate dynamo + lighting set-up for all-terrain and multi-surface adventures. See 'Accessories + Upgrades' for details.

Available with a choice of the best 650B and 700C tyres from Panaracer, WTB, Rene Herse and Schwalbe.

Full Campagnolo Ekar 1x13spd mechanical groupset.

'Made in Italy' Campagnolo components.

Dedacciai, custom formed, triple-butted performance Aluminium frame with Mason RangeFinder AS full carbon Thru-Axle fork.

components.description: Ø12mm Thru-axle Front / Ø12mm Thru-axle rear.
The RangeFinder fork is designed for 160 or 180mm rotor [using flat-mount adaptor]. 160mm is the maximum recommended diameter for the rear, 140mm minimum.
RangeFinder AS carbon fork which is custom-tuned for the Bokeh. Features pannier & ‘rando’ style rack mounts, triple accessory mounts, Ø12mm Thru-axle, 160/180mm flat-mount.
